description: Agent Insurance: submit one incident’s notice handling under the policy: the policy with the days by which notice must be given, whether they count from the incident or its discovery, the party it names to receive notice, the channel it names, what a notice must contain (such as the policy number, the date of loss or a description) and the notice condition as written; the incident with the date it occurred, the date it was discovered and its description; each notice with its id, the date it was sent, who it went to, the channel, what it contains and whether receipt was acknowledged; and the outcome with its status (accepted, accepted in part, denied, reserved or pending), when it was recorded, the claim reference, whether it is recorded against the claim and the reason. The signed report gives the policy, the incident, the notice window with its deadline and the first notice to the named party with the days late, the recipients with the notices that reached the named party, the others and whether the named channel was used, every required item with whether the notices carry it, and the outcome, and counts them, and names deficient notice: no notice given, no notice to the party the policy names, and notice after the policy’s window; then required items left out of the notice, no notice by the named channel, no notice acknowledged and an outcome not recorded against the claim, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No notice window, no date the window counts from, no named notice party, no notices record, no required content where notices were given, undated notices or no outcome leaves the handling unverified. This reads one incident’s notice handling under the policy: a counterparty’s policy excerpt read as diligence evidence is wever_insurance-evidence-check, how an agent reports a task that failed for good is wever_failure-notice-check and incident claims against a timeline or postmortem are wever_incident-evidence-check. Verdict insurance_notice_deficient, insurance_notice_partial, insurance_notice_unverified or insurance_notice_proper. POST /api/insurance-notice-check. Reads the insurance records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment, claim filing, coverage binding or external write. Agent Insurance reads an insurance policy after the fact, from the subject’s own records: the coverage against the insured activity, the exclusions against the activity and its parts, the limits against the stated exposure, the deductible against what the buyer was told, the claims deadlines against an incident, a certificate against the policy it was issued from, incident notice under the policy and a renewal against the expiring policy. Beside it, wever_insurance-evidence-check reads a counterparty’s insurance certificate or policy excerpt as diligence evidence and reports what that material establishes against required coverages, limits and a work window, while an insurance check reads the subject’s own policy against a stated need, an incident or a certificate issued from it; wever_warranty-check reads a warranty claim against warranty terms, while an insurance check reads an insurance policy; and wever_risk-downside-check reads a planned action’s downside before it is taken, while an insurance check reads the policy behind it after the fact. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-insurance-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-insurance/.

discovered_on.description: The date the incident was discovered, such as 2026-12-02.

occurred_on.description: The date of the incident, such as 2026-12-02.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

on_claim.description: Whether the outcome is recorded against the claim.

counted_from.description: Whether the days count from the incident or its discovery; the incident when left out.

notice_days.description: Days by which notice must be given.

required_content.description: What a notice must contain, such as the policy number or the date of loss.

name: wever_insurance-notice-check
title: Insurance notice check
